test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct idiom that can substitute the italicised group of words in the given sentence.**

Will humanity overcome the greed of leaders all around the world? This is the *most important issue to be discussed* today.

options.text: burn the candle at both ends
burn a hole in the pocket

solution:
The correct answer is: **Burning question**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Burning question**" means an urgent or important issue that needs to be addressed. (एक अत्यावश्यक या महत्वपूर्ण मुद्दा जिस पर ध्यान देने की आवश्यकता है)

 
 
• **Example**: *In the meeting, the team discussed the burning question of how to improve customer satisfaction and retention.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase "**the most important issue to be discussed today**" can be replaced with "**burning question**".
 
• This idiom is appropriate because it conveys a sense of urgency and importance in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
